English: Earthen Pit
A simple pit dug into the earth to store maize, protected from the elements but vulnerable to pests and decay.
Woven Basket
Large, sturdy baskets woven from reeds and grasses, enabling safer, portable maize storage for traveling clans.
Mudbrick Hut
A small, mudbrick structure keeps maize cool and safer from animals, improving storage capacity and food security.
Thatched Silo
A tall, thatched storage silo keeps maize dry and allows for seasonal surplus, encouraging population and horde growth.
Rodent-Proof Store
Elevated and sealed storage, using stone or clay, virtually eliminates pest loss and enables larger stable surpluses.
Guarded Pavilion
A fortified tented store with dedicated guards ensures security for maize reserves, supporting larger hordes and improved sentiment.
Market Storehall
A grand storage hall at the center of trade, facilitating efficient distribution and improved clan prosperity.
Expanded Granary
Vast, permanent storage complexes using advanced building techniques, able to support booming populations and massive hordes.
Grain Exchange Hall
A formal maize exchange and distribution center bringing together traders, clans, and merchants, greatly enhancing prosperity and unity.
Mesoamerican Maize Granary
A monumental granary complex, blending stone, wood, and ceremonial architecture, serves as the beating heart of nomad prosperity and power.
